_notes.purpose: Project-level MCP server config for PAI-147. Loaded by Claude Code when this repo is opened. Per-developer overrides go in ~/.claude/settings.local.json or the user-level MCP config.
_notes.auth_setup: github requires GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN in the parent shell at Claude Code launch (or substitute via `gh auth token` if you prefer not to keep a long-lived PAT). linear uses OAuth on first connect (mcp.linear.app handles the flow). context7 is unauthenticated. The other servers do not require credentials.
_notes.TODO_PAI_147_sandbox_runner: Reserved slot for a sandbox-runner MCP. Candidate providers: e2b (https://e2b.dev) and modal (https://modal.com). Activation deferred until a concrete sandboxed-execution use case appears (e.g. agent running untrusted generated code; eval framework needing isolated runs). Activate by adding an entry under mcpServers with the provider's recommended command.
_notes.TODO_PAI_149_python_reference_servers: The Anthropic reference servers for time, fetch, and git are Python packages run via `uvx`, which is NOT currently provisioned in this Dev Container. Tracked in PAI-149 (https://linear.app/paint-creek-software/issue/PAI-149). Once uv ships, add under mcpServers: time = uvx mcp-server-time; fetch = uvx mcp-server-fetch; git = uvx mcp-server-git --repository /workspaces/felafel.
